Do not treat presence/absence in this interface as proof that the premises currently operate.

limitations: This is a bounded audit of known high-risk leads, not a live operating-status verification of all 38,280 directory entries.
SFA Track Records does not provide a public bulk current/cancelled licence status in the queried interface.
Mall/operator locator inclusion confirms listing, not necessarily same-day physical operation.
Permanent-closure recommendations require explicit source language plus exact outlet/address/licence identity.
